//: Type-checking config for ESLint and for tests.
The per-package tsconfigs are BUILD configs: composite, emitting, and excluding
test files so that dist/ contains only shipped code. That leaves *.test.ts
outside every project, which type-aware linting cannot work with.
This config covers everything instead, emits nothing, and is what both
`eslint` and the test half of `pnpm typecheck` point at. A type error in a test
is a failure — a test that does not compile is not protecting anything.
